# Содержимое файла blockListControl.ts {#sec-api-blockListControl .appendix}

``` python
import { Response, Request } from 'express';
import { createDb, getQuery, runQuery } from '../../db/queryDb';

type BlockListCountriesType = {
    clientId: number,
    countryCodes: string,
    getAll: boolean
}

type BlockListDomainsType = {
    clientId: number,
    domains: {
        label: string,
        type: "edit" | "insert" | "delete",
        oldLabel: string
    },
    getAll: boolean
}

export const getBlockListCountries = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { clientId, countryCodes, getAll }: BlockListCountriesType = req.body;

    if (!clientId) {
        return res.json({ success: false, info: 'Не указан clientId' });
    }

    const db = createDb(res);

    try {
        await runQuery(
            db,
            `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS block_countries (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                clientId TEXT NOT NULL,
                countries_codes TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(clientId, countries_codes)
            )`,
            []
        );

        if (getAll) {
            const records = await getQuery<{ countries_codes: string }>(
                db,
                'SELECT countries_codes FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ?',
                [clientId]
            );
            
            return res.json({ success: true, info: records.map(r => r.countries_codes) });
        } 
        
        let newCodes: string[] = [];
        if (typeof countryCodes === 'string' && countryCodes.trim().length > 0) {
            const rawCodes = countryCodes.split(',').map(c => c.trim()).filter(Boolean);
            newCodes = Array.from(new Set(rawCodes)); // Set уберет дубликаты, если они есть в строке
        }

        const existingRecords = await getQuery<{ countries_codes: string }>(
            db,
            'SELECT countries_codes FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ?',
            [clientId]
        );
        const existingCodes = existingRecords.map(r => r.countries_codes);

        const toDelete = existingCodes.filter(code => !newCodes.includes(code));
        const toInsert = newCodes.filter(code => !existingCodes.includes(code));

        if (toDelete.length > 0) {
            const placeholders = toDelete.map(() => '?').join(', ');
            await runQuery(
                db,
                `DELETE FROM block_countries WHERE clientId = ? AND countries_codes IN (${placeholders})`,
                [clientId, ...toDelete]
            );
        }

        if (toInsert.length > 0) {
            const placeholders = toInsert.map(() => '(?, ?)').join(', ');
            const queryParams = toInsert.flatMap(code => [clientId, code]);

            await runQuery(
                db,
                `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_countries (clientId, countries_codes) VALUES ${placeholders}`,
                queryParams
            );
        }

        return res.json({ success: true });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Ошибка в getBlockListCountries:', e);
        return res.json({
            success: false,
            info: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        });
    } finally {
        db.close();
    }
};

export const getBlockListDomains = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const { clientId, domains, getAll }: BlockListDomainsType = req.body;

    if (!clientId) {
        return res.json({ success: false, info: 'Не указан clientId' });
    }

    const db = createDb(res);

    try {
        await runQuery(
            db,
            `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS block_domains (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                clientId TEXT NOT NULL,
                domains TEXT NOT NULL,
                UNIQUE(clientId, domains)
            )`,
            []
        );

        if (getAll) { 
            const getDomainsResp = await getQuery<{ domains: string }>(
                db,
                'SELECT domains FROM block_domains WHERE clientId = ?',
                [clientId]
            );

            const formattedDomains = getDomainsResp.map((d, index) => ({
                label: d.domains,
                id: index
            }));

            return res.json({ success: true, info: formattedDomains });
        } 
        
        if (!domains || !domains.type || !domains.label) {
            return res.json({ success: false, info: 'Некорректные данные домена' });
        }

        switch (domains.type) {
            case 'insert':
                await runQuery(
                    db,
                    `INSERT OR IGNORE INTO block_domains (clientId, domains) VALUES (?, ?)`,
                    [clientId, domains.label]
                );
                break;
                
            case 'delete':
                await runQuery(
                    db,
                    `DELETE FROM block_domains WHERE clientId = ? AND domains = ?`,
                    [clientId, domains.label]
                );
                break;
                
            case 'edit':
                if (!domains.oldLabel) {
                    return res.json({ success: false, info: 'Не указан старый домен для редактирования' });
                }
                await runQuery(
                    db,
                    `UPDATE block_domains SET domains = ? WHERE clientId = ? AND domains = ?`,
                    [domains.label, clientId, domains.oldLabel]
                );
                break;
                
            default:
                return res.json({ success: false, info: 'Неизвестный тип операции' });
        }

        return res.json({ success: true });

    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Ошибка в getBlockListDomains:', e);
        return res.json({
            success: false,
            info: 'Произошла непредвиденная ошибка'
        });
    } finally {
        db.close();
    }
}
```
